feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Reporting on the money that flows through our economy, from Wall Street financial firms to Silicon Valley tech giants, small businesses, consumers, employers and workers. Plus podcast episodes of Planet Money and The Indicator.

entry.title: 5 simple ways to relieve the aches and pains of sitting at a desk all day
entry.summary: Sitting at a desk all day hurts. And it isn't good for us. Strategies to make it a little more comfortable, from eye muscle exercises to alleviate eye strain to a back pain-fighting body movement.

entry.title: How long does it take to save up for a starter home? Twice as long as it did in 2019
entry.summary: A new analysis finds that the average renter household now needs 16 years to save for a down payment and closing costs. Rising rents and other costs have consumed a growing share of household budgets.

entry.title: See how Big Tech is transforming Spain's landscape
entry.summary: A drought-stricken region of northeast Spain has become a focus for American companies searching for locations to place their data centers.

entry.title: Elon Musk says Space X and Tesla are considering a merger
entry.summary: CEO Elon Musk says both Space X and Tesla have formed special committees to discuss the idea of a merger, but a merger would require approval of 50% of shareholders.

entry.title: Netflix holds quarterly earnings call following leadership shakeup and layoffs
entry.summary: Netflix reported its latest quarterly earnings on Tuesday. It comes as the streaming company has announced a management shakeup and layoffs of more than 1,000 employees.

entry.title: FAA clears the way for airlines to put Boeing's long-delayed 737 Max 10 into service
entry.summary: Nearly a decade after Boeing unveiled its largest 737 Max jet, the company has cleared a major hurdle in its effort to bring the plane to airlines.

entry.title: What if an AI bubble bursts — and that accelerates AI job losses?
entry.summary: Research on past recessions suggests downturns can accelerate automation. That raises the specter of a double whammy for workers.

entry.title: Why these 5 everyday items fluctuate in price at the grocery store
entry.summary: Here's what's behind the fluctuating costs of everyday grocery items such as ground beef, eggs and chocolate chip cookies.

entry.title: TikTok staff raised child safety alarms. Court records show executives failed to act
entry.summary: The warnings surfaced in a trove of unreported court records. "I have been fighting about fixing this for months with people who didn't think the harms are severe enough," wrote one executive.

entry.title: Difficult times in agriculture are making it tough for the next generation of farmers
entry.summary: Many farmers across the U.S. are reaching retirement age. But lately, increasing volatility and sky-high prices in agriculture are making it tough for the next generation to take over.
